verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several built-in AI assistants for delegating work. Users can 'hand off the busywork' by describing a task once, after which it is 'done automatically, reviewed by you'. AI Close agents reconcile accounts and review transactions, Accounting AI runs prompts on the ledger and imports PDFs/CSVs, an 'ask AI' button helps with categorization, and users can ask questions in plain English, all metered by included AI credits. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, and deeper documentation of how broad the assistant's task scope is beyond accounting workflows.
